send.title: Send Wake-on-LAN packets
send.description: Wake a host by sending a magic packet to its MAC address.

macAddress.label: MAC address
macAddress.description: The host's network MAC address, used to send Wake-on-LAN packets.

broadcastAddress.label: Broadcast address
broadcastAddress.description: The subnet broadcast address to send the packet to. Leave blank for 255.255.255.255.
